gui.manyl_mod.valkyrie.gift_bar_hint: Hold a flower, gem, gold, or sweet food to give as a gift
gui.manyl_mod.valkyrie.perk.none: Perk: invite her to unlock care & protective aura
gui.manyl_mod.valkyrie.perk.friend: Perk: heals you when your HP drops below 50%
gui.manyl_mod.valkyrie.perk.crush: Perk: Speed + Regen aura & shares snacks
gui.manyl_mod.valkyrie.perk.beloved: Perk ♥: Regen/Speed aura + emergency low-HP rescue
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.wild_greetin: Greetings, traveler. I wander these lands seeking a worthy companion. Shall we journey together?
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.recruited: I gladly join your side! Together we need fear no darkness.
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.need_recruit: Invite me to travel with you first, and my blade will be yours.
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.greet.ally: My blade and wings are at your service. Where do we march next?
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.greet.friend: Good to see you, my friend! Every journey feels brighter beside you.
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.greet.crush: I was just thinking about you... How are you feeling today?
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.greet.belove: Seeing your smile makes everything worthwhile. My heart is always at peace near you ♥
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.greet.jealou: Hmph... Did you finally remember me instead of the other Valkyries?
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.talk.ally.0: My armor is forged from silver and steel, yet true strength comes from who we protect.
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.talk.ally.1: If you find spare food or better weapons on our path, I am always ready to help.
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.talk.ally.2: The wilds can be harsh, but I will guard your back at every step.
I truly enjoy traveling with you. You have a kind heart and care deeply for your companions.
After a hard battle, nothing beats pausing together beneath the quiet stars.
When you are near, even the cold steel of my wings feels warm.
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.talk.crush.0: You know... I keep catching myself looking for you even when everything around us is calm.
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.talk.crush.1: Please promise me you will stay safe in battle. I worry about you so much...
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.talk.crush.2: If offered the whole world or one more peaceful evening beside you, I would choose you every time.
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.talk.beloved: While I am by your side, no shadow will harm you. My love burns warmer than any rune ♥
My favorite part of every adventure is simply sharing the road with you.
Stay safe, my love. My aura will watch over and rescue you whenever danger strikes ♥
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.compliment.e: Oh... thank you! No one has spoken such kind words to me before.
Thank you. Hearing that from you means a lot.
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.compliment.c: You make my heart race... Thank you, your words mean the world to me ♥
Really? I tried so hard to shine for you... I cannot help smiling when you say that.
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.compliment.b: With words like yours, I feel like I could soar above the clouds! I love you ♥
Even the brightest diamonds fade beside the warmth you bring into my life ♥
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.gift_hint: Hold a flower, diamond, amethyst, emerald, gold, or tasty food and press Give Gift.
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.gift.flower: Such a lovely flower... Thank you! I will keep it close to my heart ♥
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.gift.diamond: A radiant diamond! This gift is priceless, just like your kindness ♥
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.gift.gem: An enchanted gem... Its glow reminds me of your eyes. Thank you!
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.gift.gold: Fine gold! Thank you for such a thoughtful gift.
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.gift.sweet: Mmm, so sweet and delicious! You always know how to brighten my day ♥
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.gift.food: Thank you for the treat and your care — I feel full of energy!
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.confess_too_: I love traveling with you, let us grow just a little closer first...
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.confess_alre: My heart is already completely yours ♥
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.confess_succ: I waited so long to hear those words... My heart and my blade are yours forever ♥
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.mode_stay: Alright, I will wait right here and guard this spot.
dialogue.manyl_mod.valkyrie.mode_follow: I am right behind you again!
msg.manyl_mod.valkyrie_rescue: §d[Valkyrie]§r "Hold on! I've got you!" §c(Emergency care shield ♥)
msg.manyl_mod.valkyrie_share_food: §d[Valkyrie]§r "Here, have a bite to keep your strength up ♥"
msg.manyl_mod.valkyrie_jealous_warn: §6[Valkyrie is jealous]§r "Hmph... Don't give the others more attention than me!"
msg.manyl_mod.valkyrie_jealous_slap: §c[Valkyrie is jealous]§r "Hmph! Eyes over here!" §7(-1♥, jealousy 75%)
